row.notes: Fills the facility capacity panel VM nodes from a facility record: used count = facility+0x148 plus Career_Sum_FacilityNodesCompleted_A4 (overridden by optional value at +0x50 when flag +0x54 set), capacity = round(float +0x58), +0x128 amount; computes status 0/1/2 (over/equal/under capacity) and writes bools at panel+0x28/0x48/0x68/0x88, ints at +0xc8..+0x148, KM-suffix texts at +0x168..+0x1e8, resource point texts (Career_Eval_FacilityNodeEffectCurve, plus and minus) at +0x208/+0x228. Picks icon paths by facility type byte facility[0] (0..2) and status, then binds 2-3 sub rows via FUN_1419845b0 with slot ids per type (2,0,1 / 3,4,5 / 6,7). Good hook to read live facility capacity numbers. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): partial, better name Career_Populate_FacilityNodeInfoPanel: It sets bool/int/string/icon nodes from facility fields (nodes-completed sum, effect curve, resource-points text, K/M number text, 3-way state flags), but nothing in the code shows a capacity concept and it populates values rather than binding nodes.
